description: This file contains shell script code that runs automated tests related to Git push operations, including tests for push success, failure, atomic pushes, forced pushes, and cleanup routines. It simulates various scenarios of Git push commands and captures the output for validation, testing the correctness of Git push behavior in different conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, running the provided shell commands and verifying output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a shell command expecting it to fail; used for testing error conditions.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output to remove non-essential, unstable, or user-specific content for consistent verification.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves an expected output block for comparison against actual output.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares two references or ref lists for equality.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Transforms raw command output into a user-friendly, stable format for testing.
